# RNVCO

> RNVCO is a unit of Rycoon building India's sovereign AI data centre network — 2.4 GWh planned capacity across three deployment phases. Coming soon.

RNVCO provides purpose-built GPU and AI compute infrastructure designed for data sovereignty, enterprise and government workloads, and pan-India low-latency coverage.

## Core

- [Homepage](https://rnvco.com/): Overview of RNVCO capacity, three-phase roadmap, vision, and early interest registration
- [Deployment Phases](https://rnvco.com/#phases): Phase 1 (400 MWh launching), Phase 2 (1.0 GWh planned), Phase 3 (1.0 GWh planned)
- [Register Interest](https://rnvco.com/#waitlist): Early interest form for enterprises, investors, government bodies, and technology partners

## Facts

- Total planned capacity: 2.4 GWh
- Phase 1 launch capacity: 400 MWh
- Parent company: Rycoon
- Focus: Sovereign AI compute, Tier 4-style facilities, DPDP Act 2023 and MEITY compliance
- Planned hubs: Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, Bangalore, Chennai
